exposure: severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) infection
cohort: 241 pregnant women with laboratory-confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection who gave birth from March 13 to April 12, 2020, at five New York City medical centers
finding: During the first month of the SARS-CoV-2 outbreak in New York City, most pregnant women with confirmed infection were asymptomatic at admission, but almost one-third developed symptoms during hospitalization; obesity was associated with COVID-19 severity and higher rates of cesarean and preterm birth.
mod_finding: Cesarean birth was the mode of delivery for 52.4% of women with severe COVID-19 and 91.7% with critical COVID-19.
